text.en:
No. S 45 HALAL CERTIFICATE AND HALAL LABEL (AMENDMENT] ORDER, 2017 (S 512017) Notification of comluencement In exercise of the power conferred by section l(1) of the Halal Certificate and Halal Label (Amendment) Order. 2017, the Minister of Religious Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 26th May 2017 as the date on which that Order shalI commence. Dated this 20th. day of Rejab, 1438 Hijriah corresponding to the 17th. day of ApriI, 2017.

PEHIN UDANA KHATIB DATO PADUKA SERI SETIA

USTAZ HAJI AWANG BADARUDDIN BIN PENGARAH

DATO PADUKA HAJI AWANG OTHMAN Minister of Religious Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
